model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the changes over time for three different policy indices: "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt" (overall economic policy), "Finanzpolitik" (financial policy), and "Handelspolitik" (trade policy). The x-axis represents time in years on a linear scale, ranging from 2016 to just past 2024, with tick marks at two-year intervals (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024). The plot utilizes dual y-axes. The left y-axis, labeled "Index," operates on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.000 with tick intervals of 100. The right y-axis, also labeled "Index," operates on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9.000 with tick intervals of 1.000. The solid black line without markers, representing "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt" on the left scale, begins at approximately 70 in 2016, fluctuates below 200, experiences a sharp peak near 500 in early 2020, declines back to the 100-200 range, and ends with a steep upward spike to approximately 700. The solid light blue line without markers, representing "Finanzpolitik" on the left scale, closely tracks the black line, starting near 70 in 2016, peaking at approximately 430 in early 2020, and ending with a sharp spike to roughly 600. The solid purple line without markers, representing "Handelspolitik" on the right scale, begins near 0 in 2016, exhibits a peak of approximately 2.000 just before 2020, remains near 0 from 2020 through 2024, and concludes with a dramatic spike to approximately 8.000 at the end of the x-axis.
